tldr: Mercury in the 11th house routes the mind and voice through community and future vision.
body: With Mercury in the 11th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through friendship, community, networks, hopes, audiences, and the future. This makes how you belong, collaborate, and give your gifts to something larger than yourself a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through community and future vision.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in community and future vision.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
